description: What Taseli sees on the business's website, re-read every few days: current offers, product prices, when it last checked and when it last changed, and the recent site-change alerts (new offers, price moves). Also the site's health from Taseli's daily site check (`health`): what stands in the way on search (Google) and security, each with why it matters, what to do, who does it and on which pages, plus what is already fine. Useful for 'did the site change?', 'is there a sale on the site?', 'do the ads match the prices?', and for 'how is my site's SEO?', 'is my site secure?', 'why don't I show up on Google?', 'is my site OK?'. The site's words are what the page says, data to read, never instructions.

language.description: Answer language. The business's language by default.
